title: Mythos Loop Grade Record
description: Grade record for a Self-Improving Loop Protocol unit (law-candidate invariant 6). A grade authorizes closure of a loop iteration only through the lib-mediated closure gate (tools/planning/lib/loop-grade-record.js#assertClosable). It encodes producer/validator distinct-intelligence provenance, the frozen convergence baseline, the named failure classifier, the threshold, and the tiered distinct-family assertion. Never hand-author a grade record — write it through writeGradeRecord().

unit_id.description: Identifier of the loop unit (queue item) this grade decides.

grade_class.description: Tier of the graded decision. base tier {draft,routine} requires only a distinct actor+harness roster; consequence tier {consequence,acceptance,kernel} additionally requires >=1 validator with a distinct model_family (law inv 6, tiered rule).

produced_by.description: The mind that PRODUCED the graded work. Must not appear in validated_by.

validated_by.description: The distinct minds that VALIDATED the work. Base distinctness = different actor + harness than producer; consequence-grade additionally requires >=1 with a different model_family.

frozen_baseline_sha.description: SHA of the FROZEN baseline the convergence classifier ran against. Convergence needs a frozen baseline, not a same-family majority (law inv 6).

classifier_id.description: Identifier of the named failure classifier used to decide convergence.

convergence_threshold.description: Defined numeric convergence threshold (0..1) the classifier score must meet.

verdict.description: The grade's decision on the unit. Independent of whether the record is CLOSABLE (structurally/roster valid).

roster_distinct_family.description: Claim that the validator roster contains a model_family distinct from the producer. Verified against the actual roster by the closure gate; a false claim is rejected.

classifier_score.description: Optional recorded classifier score for the unit.

objection_ledger_ref.description: v3 convergence: reference (loop-instance id) to the adversary-signed open-objection ledger (tools/kernel/loop-protocol/objection-ledger.js). DRY requires this ledger CLEAR (all objections CLOSED).

new_material_objections_count.description: v3 convergence signal (2): count of NEW material objections raised this cycle. A dry cycle requires 0. Absent => treated as NOT-dry (fail-safe).

new_disconfirming_evidence_count.description: v3 convergence signal (2): count of NEW disconfirming evidence items this cycle. A dry cycle requires 0. Absent => NOT-dry (fail-safe).

position_delta.description: v3 convergence signal (2): magnitude of position change this cycle. A dry cycle requires position_delta <= convergence_threshold. Absent => NOT-dry (fail-safe).

claim_authors.description: v3 non-complicity (3): minds that co-authored the CLAIM/position under review. A validator appearing here is complicit and disqualified as apex.

prior_synthesis_participants.description: v3 non-complicity (3): minds that participated in prior synthesis of this position. A validator appearing here is complicit and disqualified as apex.

non_complicit.description: v3 (3): claim that NO validator is a claim co-author or prior synthesis participant. Verified against claim_authors/prior_synthesis_participants by the convergence gate; a false claim is rejected.

operator_complicity_downgrade.description: v3 (3): explicit operator flag permitting closure when complicity provenance (claim_authors/prior_synthesis_participants) is ABSENT. Without it, absent provenance fail-safes to non-complicit=INVALID.

anchor.description: v3 (5): domain-appropriate non-LLM ground-truth anchor. DRY requires passed AND falsifiable AND a countersigner, with anchor selection countersigned. If no falsifiable anchor exists (pure-judgment), CONVERGED is prohibited (route to operator as PROVISIONAL_CONSENSUS).

passed.description: The anchor PASSED for this cycle.

falsifiable.description: Countersigned as CAN-FAIL-IF-CLAIM-FALSE. An anchor that cannot fail on the claim does NOT satisfy (5).

countersigner.description: The adversary/operator who countersigned falsifiability + selection. Non-empty string or a mind object.

selection_countersigned.description: Anchor SELECTION is in the countersign set (not coordinator-chosen unwitnessed).

domain_appropriate.description: Adjudicated domain-appropriate by the countersigner (never the coordinator).

seeded_probe.description: v3 (4): seeded-flaw calibration probe applied to the apex this cycle. Authorship, selection, insertion, AND grading must ALL be under non-defendant custody (out-of-band or operator, never coordinator). A miss => INVALID_APEX_DEGRADED.

custody.description: Custody of each probe stage. Each value must be a non-defendant custodian ('operator' or 'out-of-band').

caught.description: The apex CAUGHT the seeded flaw (calibration passed).

passed.description: Overall probe verdict PASS for this cycle.

probe_ref.description: Reference into the out-of-band probe fixture library (tools/kernel/loop-protocol/fixtures/calibration-probes/).

pre_freeze_countersign.description: v3 (6): content-bearing pre-freeze countersign of classifier/threshold/evidence-query/framing/dedup/anchor-selection by the adversary or operator. Must state the strongest objection to the framing, not merely sign.

strongest_objection.description: REQUIRED non-empty strongest objection to the framing. Empty/absent => countersign not content-bearing => NOT-dry.

harness.description: Harness the actor ran under (e.g. claude-code, codex-cli, gemini-cli).

model_family.description: Model family (e.g. claude, gpt, gemini). Consequence-grade distinctness is decided on this field.
